propositions: Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) seeded out-of-band in AWS SSM lack terraform management and are not delivered to the deployed MCP container, causing bridge_check_access to fail with exit code 2
JIRA_PROJECT configuration must flow from SSM through fetch-secrets.sh and the compose .env to the MCP container environment, with value parity to rebar.toml [jira] project verified by test

Four credential/project variables must be carried via .env file only for compose/mcp_run_new parity, not via -e flags which would resolve empty in the deploy shell and clobber the real values from .env

Optional credential reads in fetch-secrets.sh must not fail-fast (soft degrade): absent Jira credentials are an outbound integration concern, not an auth boundary, and must not abort the entire MCP deploy or take the endpoint down

Three plain-text SSM String parameters (jira-url, jira-user, jira-project) must be read without --with-decryption while JIRA_API_TOKEN SecureString uses decryption, mirroring GitHub Actions vars vs secrets split
bridge_check_access probe reaches credential code path without fail-closed missing_credentials or missing_project verdict, but remains blocked by absent acli transport binary (separate defect)
